eject.externalBody: Speaker cleaning works through the device speaker, not headphones or Bluetooth outputs.

guide.title: Turbo Mode
guide.description: A stronger cleaning cycle for stubborn water and debris.
guide.frequency: Uses five distinct dual-frequency stages that keep evolving through the full cycle.
guide.duration: Turbo may briefly exceed the system volume limit. Use it only for short cleaning cycles.

help.title: How to use
help.disconnect: Disconnect headphones and Bluetooth devices so the cleaning sound plays through this device.
help.position: Place the device speaker-side down on a dry surface and keep the speaker openings clear.
help.start: Turn up the device volume, tap Start cleaning, and keep the device still until the cycle finishes.
help.hearingWarning: Do not wear headphones while testing Eject. The loud cleaning tones may cause hearing damage.

stereo.autoHint: Switch among left, right, and both channels
stereo.helpTap: Tap the left or right speaker to test that channel immediately.
stereo.helpBoth: Turn on both speakers to play the test tone through both channels.
stereo.helpAuto: Use Auto switch to test the left, right, and both channels in sequence.
stereo.helpStop: Use Stop test whenever you want to end playback.

meter.permissionBody: Microphone access is used only while the dB Meter is running to estimate nearby sound levels. Audio samples are processed in memory and never saved or uploaded. Rounded session estimates are stored only on this device and can be cleared in Settings.

help.title: dB Meter guide
help.stepPlace: Place the phone where you want to check the sound.
help.stepStart: Tap Start measuring and watch the live estimate.
help.examplesApproximate: Examples are approximate and vary with distance.
help.exposureDescription: NIOSH workplace-noise guidance: every 3 dB increase halves the recommended exposure time.
help.tipMicrophoneBody: Avoid covering the microphone with your hand or phone case.
help.tipPositionBody: Move the device to the location you want to assess.
help.tipProtectTitle: If it feels too loud, protect your ears
help.tipProtectBody: Move away from the source or use hearing protection.

safety.title: Audio Safety & Privacy
safety.intro: Use these tools carefully and understand what your phone can—and cannot—measure.
safety.playbackBody: Start at low volume, raise it gradually, keep the speaker away from your ears, and stop if a sound is uncomfortable.
safety.routingBody: Speaker-cleaning sound must use the device speaker. Stereo separation depends on the connected speaker or headphones.
safety.estimateBody: Phone microphones report digital signal level rather than laboratory SPL. The app applies an estimate that varies by device.
safety.privacyBody: The microphone runs only while the dB Meter is active. Samples are processed in memory and are never saved or uploaded. Rounded session estimates may be stored locally for Activity History and can be cleared in Settings.
safety.limitationsBody: This app cannot guarantee water or dust removal. Do not insert objects into the speaker, and do not use these tools as a replacement for professional repair, calibrated equipment, medical advice, or hearing protection guidance.

report.title: Sound insights
report.subtitle: A personalized look at this session
report.unlockTitle: See what this sound level means
report.unlockBody: Unlock the full environment rating, suitable activities, and listening recommendation.
report.disclaimer: Phone microphone estimates vary by device and placement. This report is general guidance, not a calibrated measurement or medical advice.

veryQuiet.label: Very quiet
veryQuiet.overview: This session suggests a very calm environment with little competing background sound.
veryQuiet.suitable: Quiet rest, reading, focused writing, meditation, and other activities that benefit from minimal distraction.
veryQuiet.recommendation: Keep the microphone uncovered and measure where you normally sit or sleep. Very low estimates can also mean the phone microphone is obstructed.

normal.label: Everyday
normal.overview: This session sits in a common everyday range, similar to a quiet home, office, or normal conversation depending on distance.
normal.suitable: Conversation, desk work, casual listening, studying, and most daily indoor activities.
normal.recommendation: If you need deeper focus, reduce nearby voices or move farther from the sound source and compare another session.

loud.label: Loud
loud.overview: This session suggests a loud environment where sound may become tiring or uncomfortable over time.
loud.suitable: Short checks of busy streets, appliances, events, or music playback where you want to understand changing levels.
loud.recommendation: Lower the source volume, increase your distance, take quiet breaks, and consider hearing protection when exposure continues.

danger.label: Potentially hazardous
danger.overview: This session suggests a very intense sound environment that deserves immediate attention.
danger.suitable: Brief safety checks only. Avoid using this environment for listening, work, rest, or extended activity.
danger.recommendation: Move away from the source, lower the volume when possible, and use appropriate hearing protection. Do not rely on a phone estimate to determine safe exposure.
